samples.xml_description:
<module id="sequence_detector">
    <description>Detects a specific 4-bit binary sequence 1001.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="reset_n">Asynchronous active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in">1-bit binary input signal representing the incoming bitstream.</input>
        <output id="sequence_detected">1-bit output signal indicating whether the sequence has been successfully detected.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">Initial state waiting for the start of the sequence.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S1">State where the first bit of the sequence is detected.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S2">State where the second bit of the sequence is detected.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S3">State where the third bit of the sequence is detected.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S4">Final state where the fourth and last bit of the sequence is detected, setting the sequence_detected output high.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="current_state" width_description="[2:0]" type="internal">Current state of the sequence detector FSM.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state" width_description="[2:0]" type="internal">Next state of the sequence detector FSM.</reg>
        
        <always @(posedge clk or posedge reset_n)> // Sequential logic block triggered on positive edge of clk or reset_n
            if (reset_n == 1'b1) begin
                current_state <= IDLE;
            end else begin
                current_state <= next_state;
            end
        </always>
        
        <always @(current_state or data_in)> // Combinational logic block triggered on change of current_state or data_in
            case(current_state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1)
                        next_state = S1;
                    else
                        next_state = IDLE;
                end
                
                S1: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0)
                        next_state = S2;
                    else
                        next_state = IDLE;
                end
                
                S2: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0)
                        next_state = S3;
                    else
                        next_state = IDLE;
                end
                
                S3: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1)
                        next_state = S4;
                    else
                        next_state = IDLE;
                end
                
                S4: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1)
                        next_state = S1;
                    else
                        next_state = IDLE;
                end
                
                default: next_state = IDLE;
            endcase
        </always>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Implements a sequence detector using a finite state machine to detect the sequence 1001.</implementation>
    <task>
        <step id="1">Define the states of the FSM.</step>
        <step id="2">Initialize the current_state register to IDLE state.</step>
        <step id="3">On every rising edge of the clock, update the current_state register to the next_state value.</step>
        <step id="4">In the sequential logic block, implement the state transitions based on the current_state and data_in inputs.</step>
        <step id="5">Use a combination of if-else statements to define the next_state values for each state.</step>
        <step id="6">Ensure that the sequence_detected output is set high only when the sequence 1001 is detected.</step>
    </task>
</module>
